## Phase / Section

Which phase or section does this feedback apply to? (e.g., "Phase 3 — Taxonomy and Reification Identification")

## Type of Feedback

- [ ] Factual error or inaccuracy
- [ ] Missing content or gap
- [ ] Unclear or ambiguous wording
- [ ] SHACL 1.2 alignment issue (spec has changed)
- [ ] Example code issue (syntax error, incorrect semantics)
- [ ] Diagram issue
- [ ] Other

## Description

A clear description of the issue or suggestion.

## Suggested Change (optional)

If you have a specific wording or code suggestion, provide it here.

## SHACL 1.2 Reference (if applicable)

If this relates to a specific SHACL 1.2 spec section or GitHub issue, link it here.
